svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: A photo of an RTX 4090 graphics card's circuit board. Each part of my tech stack is outlined on it in its own colour. Languages (the GPU): C++, C, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Swift. Embedded (the power input): ESP32, FreeRTOS, PlatformIO, Raspberry Pi. Systems (the memory chips): Linux, NixOS, bubblewrap, dinit, Docker. Networks (the PCIe connector): ROS 2, CycloneDDS, BATMAN-adv, UDP. Apps (the display outputs): Svelte, Tone.js, Cloudflare, Tauri.
